en: Black‑and‑white nighttime winter scene of a snow‑covered park in front of a multi‑story building. In the foreground there is a bench and a tree blanketed in snow, with snowy ground and bare trees lining a street. In the background, a tall vertical neon sign on the building reads "OPERKKAFFEE," indicating a café. Street lamps illuminate the falling or settled snow, creating a quiet, atmospheric city view. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.
